The '''''Tector''-class''' was a class of [[Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="The Levers of Power" /> It notably differed from other Star Destroyer classes, as it lacked a ventral [[hangar]] bay.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}}</ref> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY]].</ref> one<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> ''Tector''-class [[Starship|vessel]], [[Harbinger (Tector-class)|''Harbinger'']], was part of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[fleet]] defending the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] over the [[Endor|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="The Levers of Power" />

After [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Military|forces]] launched an [[Battle of Endor|assault]] on the seemingly incomplete [[battle station]], the Imperial fleet trapped them, as planned by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Just as the Alliance began attacking the Imperial ships, the rebel [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' crossed the [[hull]] of the ''Harbinger''.<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The Star Destroyer was later destroyed by advancing rebel vessels, and shortly after, the [[Death Star]] itself was destroyed, along with a large portion of the gathered [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]].<ref name="The Levers of Power" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TheRiseoftheEmpire.png|thumb|right|200px|The name ''Tector''-class was introduced in ''The Rise of the Empire'' compilation.]]
The ''Tector''-class first appeared as a background ship without a hangar in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. It was not named in the film,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> but the ship received a class designation in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in "[[The Levers of Power]]," a short story written by [[Jason Fry]] and included in the [[2015]] compilation book ''[[The Rise of the Empire]]''.<ref name="The Levers of Power" />

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] was first mentioned in [[Curtis Saxton]]'s [[2005]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> It was later confirmed to be the class of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] without a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] seen in ''Return of the Jedi'' by [[Leland Chee]] on the [[StarWars.com Message Boards]].<ref name="Forums">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=01200#16270670|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-02-06|time=3:45 PM|quote=That is indeed what the author was referring to when he came up with the name for the ''Tector''-class.}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] described in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' is the class of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangarless]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].</ref> Chee's declaration built off the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi: The Illustrated Edition'']] novelization, which includes a passage accompanied by concept artwork from ''Return of the Jedi'' confirming that the portion of the Tector seen in the film was its ventral [[Hull/Legends|hull]].<ref name="Star Wars Return of the Jedi The Illustrated Edition">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> In [[Wikipedia:Latin|Latin]], the word "tēctor" means "plasterer."<ref name="Collins Latin Dictionary">{{BookCite|container=Collins Dictionaries|title=Collins Latin Dictionary and Grammar|version=2nd ed.|publisher=[[Wikipedia:HarperCollins|HarperCollins]]|date=2016|isbn=978-0008167677}}</ref>
